msg: The mushroom count continuously changes, and you can't choose the same gnomes each round as a result. I couldn't entirely figure out when the switch happened, but I played the first few rounds to determine which gnomes were reliably the ones with the mushrooms at that time. Short hat then long hat usually worked. When the mushroom count went down on those gnomes, though, I switched to the other gnome in each respective set. This worked reasonably well with only a few hiccups here and there
